lines.en: Hey, I know what I want.
No, no, you don't want this.
Now, I want to have your grandmother's cookie recipe.
You mean the chocolate chip cookie recipe?
You mean the one that my grandmother made me swear on her deathbed
that I would never let out of our family?
Dying people say the craziest things.
I'm just gonna make cookies for my children.
I don't have the recipe, but here.
I wish you health and happiness.
This is what happens when you don't register for gifts.
See, no, I made a batch, and I froze it,
and this is the only one left.
I think I can figure out the recipe from this cookie.
I do stuff like this at work all the time.
Yeah, I think I can do it.
All right, I definitely taste nutmeg.
Well, that's the difference between a professional and a layman.
I don't want to talk about it.
You know, you could at least save me a whole cookie.
Look, now, the only thing that's left of my grandmother's legacy is this crumb.
I wish you a long and happy marriage.
Maybe these will taste like your grandmother's.
This has a little bit of orange peel, but no nutmeg.
Hey, well, I've not made this many cookies since I was in the ninth grade.
Well, what was that for, like a bake sale?
Yeah, but not as good as batch 17.
The ones we had right after you almost threw up.
Are there any more from the good batch?
Because we could just work off of those.
Yeah, well, yeah, I think there's one from batch 17 left.
16 people, get out of the way.
I would actually make my grandma really happy to know that we're trying to figure out her recipe.
Well, I bet she's looking up at us and smiling right now.
No, she was really nice to me, but she's in hell for sure.
I guess I'm not going to be the mom who makes the world's best chocolate chip cookies.
I do make the best duck confit with broccoli rabe.
Isn't there any relative that would have the recipe?
I made a promise to myself that the next time I would talk to Ursula is over my dead body.
And that's not happening until October 15, 2032.
That's the day you're going to die.
Well, I mean, what about friends of your grandmother's?
Well, you know, I may have relatives in France who would know.
My grandmother said she got the recipe from her grandmother, Nestlé Toulouse.
You Americans always butcher the French language.
I cannot believe that I just spent the last two days trying to figure out that
recipe and it was my cupboard the whole time.
